purpose: Services relationship: operative commitments below follow your notes. The parties are starting and operating a mobile coffee cart together. party_a funded the trailer and machines, and those items stay party_a’s personal property unless the parties sign a written transfer. party_b will run the daily operations of the cart. The business ownership split is 60/40. Spending above $500 requires approval from both parties before the expense is made. Future cash put into the business is treated as a loan first unless the parties later agree in writing to convert it into ownership. The parties want a clear buyout path if one of them wants to exit, with a first right to buy at fair market value based on trailing 6 months earnings or an independent appraisal. Monthly payouts will be made after expenses and after keeping a 10% reserve. If a dispute comes up, the parties will try mediation first and then move to binding arbitration if mediation does not resolve it.
